verdict.rationale: Snyk's docs clearly document automated fix PRs and upgrade-path remediation for Snyk Open Source (snyk-docs-21) plus newer agentic remediation tools (snyk-docs-12, snyk-docs-13, snyk-docs-29) that scan, generate fix plans, and apply fixes. However, hands-on community reports concretely contradict the quality of this in practice: users describe Snyk generating 'dozens or hundreds of PRs to update dependencies rather than rewriting them,' calling Dependabot '100x better,' and report PRs that 'miss entire versions' or wrongly replace legitimately forked packages, calling it 'a pain in the backside' (snyk-comm-2, snyk-comm-7, snyk-comm-8). missing for 10: independent verification that fix PRs are accurate/non-noisy at scale, and resolution of the forked-package/version-skip complaints.
